execution_evidence.note: The workflow executed the full Vitest suite in 24 sequential shards on the exact material head; this remediation reuses that existing green evidence and does not dispatch or rerun CI.

static_checks: Static adminProcedure contract passed for every administrative governance endpoint

controls.claim: Administrative governance mutations are exposed through adminProcedure, not a weaker protected/public procedure.
controls.observed: All listed governance administrative procedures are bound to adminProcedure on the material head.

controls.claim: Unexpected persistence errors are redacted at the public tRPC boundary and preserve correlation IDs.
controls.observed: Sensitive SQL/idempotency markers are absent from the public error while controlled domain errors remain 4xx.

controls.claim: Limitation lifecycle transitions serialize conflicting create/revoke/extend operations.
controls.observed: Concurrent create/create admits one initial window; revoke before extend causes extension rejection.

controls.claim: Active limitations are reversible and revoked state cannot be silently extended.
controls.observed: Revocation/appeal reversal semantics are preserved and a revoked initial window cannot be extended.

controls.claim: The persisted human review scope is re-read and revalidated when applying the later limitation.
controls.observed: Missing or stale review scope fails closed and an operation not approved by the human review is rejected.

controls.claim: Initial, extension and emergency limitations obey their distinct temporal destinations.
controls.observed: Seven-day initial/extension rules and 24-hour emergency protection are enforced.

controls.claim: Repeated lifecycle transitions cannot create additional normal or emergency windows.
controls.observed: Third normal limitation and chained emergency window are rejected.
